chain.title: First Smelt
chain.desc: Smelt raw tin from Tin Ore (y 60 down to -20, common in any cave) in a plain furnace. Tin goes into gears, plates, ducts and the machine frame - it never stops being asked for.

chain.title: Dig Deeper for Lead
chain.desc: Lead Ore lives from y 40 down to bedrock, so bring a deep mine. Lead is Thermal's wiring metal - energy ducts, flux capacitors and cells all drink it.

chain.title: Heavy Metal
chain.desc: Smelt the raw lead. Anything in Thermal that moves or stores Redstone Flux has lead somewhere in its recipe, so this is the metal you will run out of first.

chain.title: Nickel at Any Depth
chain.desc: Nickel Ore generates across almost the whole world height (-40 to 120) but in small pockets. You barely use nickel raw - it exists to become invar and constantan.

chain.title: The Alloy Feedstock
chain.desc: Smelt raw nickel and hold onto it. Two of the four Thermal alloys - invar and constantan - are impossible without it.

chain.title: Silver in the Deep
chain.desc: Silver Ore shares lead's depths (y 40 down to -60) and is rarer. Silver becomes electrum, silver gears for the potion tools, and the best coin fuel.

chain.title: Sterling Stock
chain.desc: Smelt raw silver. You need it for electrum, for the silver gears in the Potion Infuser and Quiver, and later for lumium - worth a dedicated branch mine.

chain.title: Alloys Without Machines
chain.desc: Craft 3 copper and 1 tin (ingots or dusts) with a Fire Charge for 4 bronze - no Induction Smelter needed. Bronze is what fluid ducts are drawn from.

chain.title: Invar Without the Smelter
chain.desc: Mix 2 iron dust with 1 nickel dust for 3 Invar Blend, then smelt it in any furnace. Invar is the workhorse mid-tier metal in machine, augment and turbo servo recipes.

chain.title: Gold, Sharpened
chain.desc: Gold plus silver with a Fire Charge gives 2 electrum. Electrum is the conductor in energy limiters and augments, and the base that signalum is alloyed from.

chain.title: Constantan Completes the Set
chain.desc: Copper plus nickel with a Fire Charge gives 2 constantan. The fourth alloy rounds out the augment and dynamo recipes, and lumium needs it down the line.

chain.title: Gearing Up
chain.desc: Four invar ingots around an iron nugget, or one ingot in the Multiservo Press with a Gear Die. Each metal has its own gear, and recipes name them specifically - invar's marks the mid tier.

chain.title: Fertilizer Rock
chain.desc: Apatite Ore is scattered from y -16 up to 96 and drops heaps of gems. Two apatite, sand and niter craft into 8 Phyto-Gro - the fertilizer the whole farming side runs on.

chain.title: Niter for the Powder Mill
chain.desc: Niter Ore peaks around y 24. Niter is the oxidizer in both Phyto-Gro and gunpowder, so it feeds your farms and your rockets at the same time.

chain.title: Gunpowder Without Creepers
chain.desc: Sulfur Ore sits low, around y -16 to 32. Charcoal, two niter and one sulfur craft 4 gunpowder - from here on, TNT and rockets no longer require creeper hunting.

chain.title: The Ore Multiplier Mineral
chain.desc: Cinnabar Ore generates from y -16 to 48. Feed cinnabar into the Pulverizer's catalyst slot to squeeze bonus secondary drops out of every ore you grind.

chain.title: Find the Rubber Tree
chain.desc: Rubberwood trees grow in flower forests, sparse jungles and bamboo jungles. Tap a trunk with an Arboreal Extractor for Latex - the rubber for cells, ducts and reservoirs.

chain.title: Strike Oil
chain.desc: Oil Sand hides in deserts and badlands between y 40 and 80 - grab it with any shovel. Squeeze it for crude oil, the fuel line that ends in the Compression Dynamo.

chain.title: Minted Power
chain.desc: Press a silver ingot with a Coin Die for 3 coins; each silver coin burns for 48,000 RF in a Numismatic Dynamo. Literal money-to-power - the flashiest fuel in the pack.

collections.note: Every metal has a gear: four ingots around an iron nugget by hand, or one ingot in the Multiservo Press with a Gear Die. Recipes across Thermal name specific gears, so the set fills in naturally.
Plates come off the Multiservo Press one ingot at a time and are the flat stock other mods' recipes request.
All eight metals mint into Numismatic Dynamo fuel via the Press Coin Die; richer metals burn hotter.
Full vanilla-style wood set from rubberwood, for builders who tapped the trees anyway.

notes: Foundation is the resource layer of the Thermal series: ores + oil sand + rubberwood worldgen, 8 metals with full dust/ingot/nugget/gear/plate/coin/block sets. All ids verified against lang keys (assets/thermal_foundation/lang plus the embedded thermal_core's assets/thermal/lang) and recipes in data/thermal/recipes/ of this jar and the embedded core. Ore heights and biomes read from data/thermal/worldgen/placed_feature and forge/biome_modifier in the jar. Fire Charge grid-alloying recipes (bronze_ingot_4, invar_ingot_3, electrum_ingot_2, constantan_ingot_2) are in this jar, so all four alloys are reachable pre-machine. Silver coin fuel value 48000 RF read from fuels/numismatic/numismatic_silver_coin.json. Deliberately does NOT reuse ids already in thermal.json's chain (raw_tin, tin_gear, invar_ingot, etc.); invar is anchored via invar_dust/invar_gear instead. Ruby and sapphire items/ores exist with loot tables but have NO placed_feature or biome_modifier - they do not generate by default, so they are excluded. apatite/niter/sulfur/cinnabar items and the phytogro/gunpowder recipes live in the embedded thermal_core jar-in-jar.
